productBrand.meaning: MAREA is the Spanish word for tide. It is used as the proposed product brand for the marine technology family.
productBrand.registrationPolicy: No registered-trademark or unregistered-trademark symbol may be attached to MAREA, and no text may present MAREA as a registered trademark, until written legal clearance exists.
productBrand.availabilityPolicy: MAREA products are not commercially available while there is no released product, no validated stock and no authorised sale. Brand copy must not assert availability.

technologyFoundation.rule: OPEN-MARINE is the internal open engineering foundation and technical identifier. It must never be presented as the public product brand, as a consumer-facing brand, or as the brand behind MAREA. Public brand copy names MAREA, sold by EMBARCARTE.
permittedContexts: legitimate technical references outside public brand copy
forbiddenContexts: public page titles, headings or logo lockups
attribution statements that present a product as OPEN-MARINE branded
using OPEN-MARINE and MAREA as interchangeable public brand names

fleetDisambiguation.rule: MAREA FLEET names two different things: (1) the MAREA FLEET product family, the professional multi-vessel operations SaaS; (2) the integrated B2B package that combines vessel SaaS, onboarding and optionally hardware and communications, whose customer-facing name is 'MAREA FLEET package'. The bundle id stays FLEET and its machine displayName stays MAREA FLEET; the customer-facing bundle form is always 'MAREA FLEET package'. Written copy must make the sense explicit whenever the context is ambiguous, for example by saying the MAREA FLEET product family or the MAREA FLEET package, and must never merge the two into a single price or offer.
fleetDisambiguation.product: MAREA FLEET product family: professional multi-vessel operations SaaS.
fleetDisambiguation.bundle: MAREA FLEET package: integrated B2B package with vessel SaaS, onboarding and optional hardware and communications.

namingRules.separator: Exactly one space between the master brand and the family identifier.

edition.rule: Edition names describe commercial packaging. They never encode hardware revisions.

generation.rule: Generation names are used only when a generation is formally defined and announced. No unannounced generation may appear in published copy.

hardwareSize.rule: Physical sizes follow the family with one space. Sizes are published only once verified enclosure capability exists.

version.rule: Software versions use semantic versioning in engineering contexts only. A version number never appears inside the commercial display name.
examples: MAREA NAV 2.4.0 is an engineering reference; the commercial name is MAREA NAV Pro.

commercialVsEngineeringIdentifier.rule: Commercial names use the MAREA naming syntax. Engineering identifiers may reference the OPEN-MARINE foundation, repository modules and versions, and are never presented as public brand names.

forbiddenPatterns: MAREA-FAMILY (any hyphen between the master brand and the family)
Marea Family (title case for the master brand or the family)
Attaching a registered-trademark or unregistered-trademark symbol to MAREA

Using a software version number as part of a commercial display name
Mixing edition names with hardware revision identifiers
namingRules.newProductRule: A new product family requires an explicit contract revision, a naming review and a legal review. Agents must not invent families.

claimsPolicy.summary: No brand or product copy may assert certification, guaranteed safety, autonomy, comparative superiority, a reliability percentage or immediate availability without an approved evidence file. Claims are limited to what has been verified.
rules: Protocol, certification and conformity claims require an approved certificate or written authorisation.
Safety and autonomy claims require verified safety evidence and an approved operating envelope.
Superlatives such as most accurate, best or safest are prohibited without independent evidence.
Reliability percentages require measured test evidence.
Availability, stock and delivery statements require released products and validated operations.
Prices are hypotheses until costed, approved and published in a released offer.

es.b2bLine: Para instaladores, marinas, escuelas y flotas: propuesta técnica con matriz de compatibilidad y plan de servicio.

en.companyDescription: EMBARCARTE sells, installs and supports marine technology for recreational and professional vessels.
en.mareaShortDescription: MAREA is EMBARCARTE's family of navigation, connectivity and instrumentation products: one vessel, one set of data.
en.mareaExtendedDescription: MAREA brings navigation, onboard data, control, sensors and monitoring together in one modular ecosystem. It is a proposed brand: it is not registered and it is not presented as a registered trademark.
en.headlinePrimary: Marine instrumentation for the boat you already own.
en.headlineSecondaryOne: All your boat's data in one place.
en.headlineSecondaryTwo: Start with what is already aboard.
en.trustLine: We publish what a product does, what it does not do, and which version does it.
en.b2bLine: For installers, marinas, sailing schools and fleets: a technical proposal with a compatibility matrix and a service plan.
en.attributionLine: MAREA is a product brand of EMBARCARTE.
